# sherpa-onnx C API header

`c-api/c-api.h` is copied unchanged from sherpa-onnx v2.0.1, commit
`af2d8d81dbfa61c4cea4c568da78f3982edca005`, the commit that built the pinned AAR
(`models/sherpa-onnx.json`):

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/af2d8d81dbfa61c4cea4c568da78f3982edca005/sherpa-onnx/c-api/c-api.h

SHA-256 `5698f38ba09ad2bdf085c56a6cbbd7741acf15e25f4ce5c7097b9702cadf437f`; Gradle refuses to
build when the file differs. Every function it declares is exported by the AAR's
`libsherpa-onnx-c-api.so` for arm64-v8a and x86_64.
